description: Hi, I'm Darshini S, currently pursuing my B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering at Chennai Institute of Technology. I have a strong interest in software development, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning. I'm familiar with Python, Java, and SQL, and I have hands-on experience through academic projects, hackathons, and internships in AI/ML. I'm always eager to learn new technologies, improve my problem-solving skills, and gain practical industry experience.
